selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What does the traveler want to do next to grow stronger in faith?
questions.answer: He wants to look at the whole universe and learn from what it shows.

questions.question: What special tool does the traveler use to look at the cosmos?
questions.answer: He uses a wide, far-seeing way of understanding that he took from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What are two things the cosmos is compared to in the passage?
questions.answer: It is compared to a book and to a palace.

questions.question: Why is the universe described as meaningful and orderly?
questions.answer: Because everything in it fits together with wisdom and purpose.

questions.question: What do the parts of the universe all point to together?
questions.answer: They point to the existence and nearness of one Creator who knows and controls everything.

questions.question: What does it mean that the signs in the universe speak “together” or “in unison”?
questions.answer: It means many different things in creation give the same message.

questions.question: According to the passage, what qualities does the Creator have?
questions.answer: He has complete knowledge, full power, wisdom, and perfect skill.

questions.question: Besides the “book” example, what else in the cosmos gives witness to the Creator?
questions.answer: All species, tiny particles, living beings, and the changes happening in the universe also give witness.

questions.question: How do changes and renewal in the universe help prove its message?
questions.answer: They show that a wise and powerful Maker is constantly managing everything.

questions.question: What main truth about Allah does the whole passage support?
questions.answer: It supports that Allah exists and that He is One.

questions.question: Why does the traveler turn to the whole cosmos after learning from smaller parts of it?
questions.answer: He wants a higher and clearer level of faith.

questions.question: How does looking at the whole universe help the traveler’s earlier lessons?
questions.answer: It makes them more complete and brighter.

questions.question: In the passage, how is the universe like a written work?
questions.answer: Its parts are like sections of a book that all carry meaning.

questions.question: What does the order in the universe show about its Maker?
questions.answer: It shows the Maker is not random but acts with knowledge and care.

questions.question: What idea is taught by saying the Maker sees everything in everything?
questions.answer: It teaches that nothing is hidden from Him and He knows every detail.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the relationships between things?
questions.answer: It says the Creator knows how all things connect with one another.

questions.question: Which small and large things in the cosmos are said to testify?
questions.answer: Both tiny particles and all kinds of creatures testify.

questions.question: What kinds of events inside the universe are mentioned as signs?
questions.answer: Things entering and leaving it, and the changes and renewing happening in it.

questions.question: What can we infer from the phrase about limitless power and endless wisdom?
questions.answer: The Maker can do whatever He wills and does it in the best way.

questions.question: According to the passage, do these signs point to many makers or one Maker? Explain briefly.
questions.answer: They point to one Maker, because all the signs give one united message.

questions.question: What is the traveler hoping to gain by studying the cosmos?
questions.answer: He is hoping to reach another level of faith.

questions.question: Where did the traveler get the understanding he uses to study the universe?
questions.answer: He got it from the Qur’an.

questions.question: What feeling do the examples of a palace and a city give about the universe?
questions.answer: They show it is arranged, beautiful, and carefully governed.

questions.question: What do the changing parts of the universe still manage to show?
questions.answer: They still show a steady message about one all-knowing and all-powerful Creator.
